title: Explicit units and rounding on ambiguous numeric questions

hypothesis.statement: Adding explicit unit and rounding instructions to numeric questions the audit flagged as ambiguous will reduce abandonment while those questions are on screen.

variants.description: For audit-flagged questions only, show a human-reviewed clarification (e.g. "Answer in minutes, rounded to 4 decimal places"). Answers, tolerances and all other questions are unchanged.

primaryMetric.definition: Among exposed units presented at least one affected question, the share who abandon the game while that question is on screen.

guardrails.definition: Share of exposed units who flag at least one question.
Share of exposed units whose games all end by finish or timer (not game_abandoned).
Share of exposed units with at least one client error (Sentry event tagged with experiment variant).

feasibility.note: At current traffic this needs ~553 days, beyond the 42-day cap: expect "inconclusive" unless the effect is much larger than the MDE. Consider a larger MDE or running without competing experiments.

evaluationPlan: Analyse only units with an experiment_exposure event (intent-to-treat from first exposure).
Daily: sample-ratio-mismatch check (chi-square, p < 0.001 pauses the experiment).
Daily: guardrails via always-valid mSPRT p-values; any significant harm recommends revert immediately.
Primary metric is not interpreted before 14 days and 200 units per arm.
After that, stop when the always-valid p < 0.05, or at 5762 units per arm / 42 days, whichever first; reaching the cap without significance is "inconclusive".
Report effect size with confidence interval, not just significance. A human makes the final keep/revert decision.
codeChangeOutline: server/question-clarifications.js: map of question_id -> reviewed clarification text (drafted by the agent, approved by a human).
Serve clarified descriptions to treatment units in /api/questions and buildTacticalSet; control receives the original text.
question_presented carries { question_id, affected: true|false, variant } so analysis can restrict to affected questions.
Persist /api/flag into a question_flags table so the dispute guardrail is measurable.
risks: Clarifications could make questions easier; that is acceptable but should be visible via affected_question_solve_rate (secondary).
Small affected set means slow accumulation.

prerequisites.description: Metric "Abandonment conditional on question difficulty and position" is instrumented in code
Metric "Question dispute rate" is instrumented in code
Consent Mode default-deny in place; experiment events only fire with analytics consent
experiment_exposure event emitted with experiment_id and variant
Treatment code reviewed and merged behind the flag (default = control)
Every clarification text reviewed and approved by a human

alternativeDesign.title: Explicit rounding/unit instructions on flagged numeric questions
alternativeDesign.treatment: The same questions show a standardised format line matching the stored answer's precision and unit (e.g. 'Enter as a decimal rounded to 4 decimal places', 'Enter in minutes', 'Enter as a decimal, not a percentage'). Answers and tolerances are unchanged.
alternativeDesign.rationale: Adding explicit rounding and unit instructions to the numeric questions that lack them will raise the share of exposed players who answer them correctly, without increasing abandonment or disputes.
